scope: Full DE10-Standard system on Cyclone V 5CSXFC6D6F31C6; RTL cycle counts exclude UART transmission. Only active architecture selections are included.

A0.name: Iterative in-place
A0.note: Đạt STA 160 MHz; setup 0.02 ns / hold 0.145 ns. 33/33 RTL khớp regression.

A1.name: Streaming ping-pong
A1.note: Đạt STA 160 MHz; setup 0.075 ns / hold 0.11 ns. 33/33 RTL khớp regression.

A2.name: Continuous banked
A2.note: Chốt A2, giữ RTL theo yêu cầu. Setup min −0,051 ns (Slow 0°C), TNS −0,092 ns; Slow 85°C +0,007 ns. Hold min +0,121 ns. Chưa đạt timing đầy đủ tại 160 MHz.

A4.name: Banked cycle-opt (giữ V2)
A4.note: Đạt 160 MHz. Giữ mã A4; tên project mới bỏ v2. Setup +0,006 ns nên biên nhỏ.

A5.name: Streaming-Balanced 4BU
A5.note: Cân bằng tốt nhất trong 2/4/8BU hiện tại: đạt 160 MHz, 40 DSP / 55 M10K. Xem So_sanh_BU.

SB2.name: Streaming-Balanced 2BU / 4 bank
SB2.note: Tiết kiệm DSP/RAM; NTT 459 chu kỳ. Setup −0,194 ns, chưa đạt 160 MHz.

SB8.name: Streaming-Balanced 8BU / 16 bank
SB8.note: NTT 127 chu kỳ, DSP 56 / M10K 66. Setup −0,512 ns, chưa đạt 160 MHz.

notes: A2, SB2 and SB8 do not meet setup at all corners for 160 MHz; nominal latency conversion is not an achieved clock claim.
The BU_COMPILE_RESULTS_20261025.json latest_a2 property is an older intermediate record; selected A2 is A2_FINAL_RESULTS_20261025.json and A2_20261025_094051.

A4 kept the historical v2 file names in its fitted snapshot; the active project directory was subsequently renamed continuous_banked_cycle_opt. Logs from the workbook source and the newer selected regression are retained.
FPGA demonstration records retain their actual acquisition timestamps; the report selection date is 25 October 2026. The SOF used for those runs was not hashed in the evidence records.
Python ACVP checking is reference-model checking, not a claim of RTL ACVP certification.
Power, ASIC physical sign-off, entropy quality certification and CDC/MTBF sign-off are not measured by these logs.
